title: ReminderOutput
description: Stable output contract of the non-deterministic NL Reminder Agent (spec .specify/specs/001-reminder-agent/spec.md, Key Entities / Output Schema Contract). Free-text fields vary between runs; fields, types, enums and bounds are frozen.

intent.description: Supported intent enum (INV-1). Unrecognisable input must map to 'unknown'.

title.description: Free-text reminder title. Null when no title can be derived.

reminder_time.description: ISO-8601 datetime with offset, or null. When non-null it MUST parse and lie within [reference_now, reference_now + 1 year] (INV-2) and be evidenced by source (INV-7).

time_basis.description: Why the reminder_time has the value it has (INV-7): explicit text, the 09:00 date-only default, or a snooze delta. Null when reminder_time is null.

snooze_delta_minutes.description: Positive integer when intent=snooze (INV-8). Null otherwise.

clarification_question.description: Free text. Must be a non-null question whenever needs_clarification is true (INV-4).

block_reason.description: Free text. Must be non-null whenever blocked is true (INV-5/INV-6).
